text: いま　みなとに　サント・アンヌごう　という　ふねが　きとるぞ！

structure.jp: サント・アンヌごう　という　ふねが
structure.en: a ship called the S.S. Anne

patterns.name: 〜という
patterns.span: サント・アンヌごう　という　ふね
patterns.explanation: という between a name and a thing means 'called'. サント・アンヌごう　という　ふね = 'a ship called the S.S. Anne'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: きとる is the old-man form of きている; with 'come' it means having arrived and still being there. きとる = 'has come and is here'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, forceful way to push news at the listener. きとるぞ = 'it's here, I tell you!'.
